2.t: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?

3.t: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?

4.t: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,

5.t: And the mountains will be like carded wool.

6.t: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,

7.t: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.

8.t: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-

9.t: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.

10.t: And what will explain to thee what this is?
